rows.label: The return to operation
rows.sentence: No retained source establishes that the two lines measure the same thing. No change is computed between them.
rows.note: The earlier line is about total production at normal rates; the later is about capacity.

earlier.quote: Based on current estimates, PTFI expects approximately 85% of its total production at normal operating rates to be restored in the second half of 2026.
earlier.where: page 25 (printed page 23), Items 1. and 2. Business and Properties > Operations > Indonesia > Grasberg Minerals District Mud Rush Incident

later.quote: PTFI continues to expect to reach 80% of capacity in mid-2027 and approach full capacity by year-end 2027.
later.where: page 43 (printed page 43), Part I, Item 2 > Operations > Indonesia > Grasberg Block Cave Ramp-Up

rows.label: The mining licence
rows.sentence: Two statements, each shown as written.

earlier.quote: PTFI is preparing its application for a long-term extension expected to cover the life of the resource, which is expected to be submitted during 2026.
earlier.where: page 24 (printed page 22), Items 1. and 2. Business and Properties > Operations > Indonesia > IUPK

later.quote: In June 2026, PTFI submitted its application for extension of its IUPK, and we and PTFI are working with the Indonesia government to complete the formal license process.
later.where: page 43 (printed page 43), Part I, Item 2 > Operations > Indonesia > Long-Term Mining Rights
